name: setup-manaflow-ai-codex-composer
description: Opt-in, for the ChatGPT replica only. A round composer is taller than one line at baseline: the prompt gets its own line and the model, effort, access, attach and Send sit in a row under it. Its + (the attach paperclip) highlights as a circle on hover, like the round mic and Send beside it. cmux's own composers are not changed: remove it and the one-line composer you had comes back.
